note: Prerecorded prompts. WAV files live at <CLIPS_DIR>/<language>/<clip_id>.wav (mono, 16-bit). Optional per-medication prompts may be added as med_<med_id>.wav; without one, med_prompt_generic is played. No clip may mention other doses or the rest of the day. All text must pass clinician review before release.

wake_greeting.en: Hello! It's time for your medicine.

reminder.zh-TW: 提醒您，現在是吃藥的時間。
reminder.en: A gentle reminder: it's time for your medicine.

searching.zh-TW: 我正在找您，請到我面前來。
searching.en: I'm looking for you. Please come in front of me.

waiting_for_patient.zh-TW: 我在等要吃藥的人，請他到我面前來。
waiting_for_patient.en: I'm waiting for the person whose medicine this is. Please ask them to come to me.

waiting_for_tablet.zh-TW: 我會等您在平板上完成。
waiting_for_tablet.en: I'll wait until you finish on the tablet.

med_prompt_generic.en: Please take your next medicine now.

already_taken.zh-TW: 這次的藥您已經吃過了，做得很好！
already_taken.en: You've already taken these medicines. Well done!

confirm_with_caregiver.zh-TW: 謝謝您。我會請家人確認這種藥。
confirm_with_caregiver.en: Thank you. I'll ask your family to confirm this medicine.

help.zh-TW: 需要幫忙嗎？準備好的時候，請在我面前吃藥。
help.en: Do you need help? When you're ready, please take your medicine in front of me.

wind_down.zh-TW: 這次就到這裡，請多保重！
wind_down.en: That's all for now. Take care!
